topNews.text: US Alcohol Consumption Falls to 85-Year Low –Driven by Desire for Better Health
topNews.excerpt: Gallop reported in August that since it began tracking the US drinking rate in 1939, it has never been lower than in 2025. Last year, just 54% of Americans polled on average said they consumed alcohol.
